REPUBLIC OF TÜRKİYE
GEBZE TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY
DIRECTIVE FOR INTERNATIONAL
GRADUATE STUDENTS
Document No YÖ-0008
Date Released 06 Dec 2017
Date Revised 30 Oct 2020
Revision 1
Page 2-1
Form No: FR-0356 Date Released: 23 Nov 2017 Rev. No: 0 Date Revised: -
Basis, Purpose, Scope
Article-1
These "Principles” have been issued to determine the a dmission requirements to be sought for foreign
national students that apply to follow graduate studies at Gebze Technical University (GTU), as per the
Regulation for Graduate Education and Teaching at Gebze Technical University (Regulation).
The Institutes at GTU may ask additional requirements when necessary provided that those requirements
are within the framework of the Regulation and these "Senate Principles".
For matters that are not specified within these “Principles”, t he terms of the current Regulation and the
relevant legislation apply.
Certificates Of Education To Be Requested From Candidates
Article-2
Apart from the documents to be requested as per the relevant legislation from foreign national students
that apply to follow graduate studies at GTU for their residence in Türkiye, the documents to be requested
related to the candidates’ studies are listed below:
a) Application form
b) Bachelor’s diploma for application to MASTER’S programs, master’s diploma for application to
DOCTORAL programs, and their approved translation into Turkish (For diplomas received from
foreign higher education institutions, the relevant Institute shall inquire from YÖK (Turkish Council of
Higher Education) the diploma’s eligibility. The a pplication shall be processed in the first semester
following the eligibility approval of YÖK).
c) If t he transcript of the completed bachelor’s or master’s program is not in English or Turkish, an
approved translation of the transcript into English is required (If the transcript is in Turkish, no translation
is required).
d) Candidates are required to meet the minimum ALES score that is specified in the announcement for
Turkish national students’ entrance exams for the type of program they are applying to. Within this scope,
the results of GRE/GMAT are also valid instead of an ALES certificate.
In addition, the previous ALES or equivalent certificates of those candidates that have applied for a
doctoral or another master’s program by taking a maximum of one-semester break after completing their
master’s studies and of those candidates that took a maximum of one-semester break because they w ere
disenrolled after they started their master’s education are also valid. (amendment: senate decision dated
07 November 2013 and numbered 2013/34-02)
e) -All candidates are re quired to meet the English lang uage requirement towards the
MASTER’S/DOCTORAL program entrance exam announced for Turkish national students.
- For 30% English-medium instruction programs, if the candidate is willing to take a course or courses
taught in Turkish, he/she is required to obtain a TÖMER certificate.
If the related program’s medium of instruction is only Turkish, then the candidate is required to obtain a
TÖMER certificate. (amendment: senate decision dated 07 November 2013 and numbered 2013/34-
02)
f) Abolished (senate decision dated 07 November 2013 and numbered 2013/34-02)
Other Requirements
Article-3
1. The quota for foreign national students is determined as a number that shall not exceed the 20% of
the quota announced for Turkish national students towards the anticipated MASTER’s and DOCTORAL
programs.
2. The candidates may apply for a maximum of 2 programs for the MASTER’S and DOCTORAL
programs provided that their diploma is eligible for the program they are applying for.
3. In terms of education and teaching, foreign national students are also subject to the Regulation that

applies to Turkish national students.
4. Enrollment procedure s of those whose application has been accepted is conducted by GTU’s
Directorate of Student Affairs. Students that do not have a student visa are not enrolled.
5. Of the candidates that have earned the right to enroll, those that fail to enroll within the time period to
be announced lose their right to enroll.
Enforcement
Article-4
These “Principles” enter into force on the date of their acceptance by the Senate.
Execution
Article-5
These “Principles” are executed by GTU Rectorate.
